_help: Said (after a beep) when you have walked far enough from the last biological sample. Field: {distance} (metres).
BioFarEnough: You're far enough away now. Take the next sample.
That's {distance} metres. Far enough. Next sample, Commander.
Far enough from the last one. Go ahead and sample.
Distance reached. You can take the next sample now.
This is far enough. Sample whenever you're ready.
BioFarEnough_Friendly: Nice walking. That's far enough, take the next sample.
BioFarEnough_Close: That's far enough, love. Go on, take your sample.
BioFarEnough_Sarcastic: Congratulations, you've walked {distance} metres. Now sample something.
